conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: Any variation from the designated curriculum must be discussed with and approved by the appropriate curriculum program director, director, executive director of curriculum and instruction, and the assistant superintendent of curriculum and instruction.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: Lesson plans are to be completed in the curriculum management system and submitted according to the campus plan weekly. ... Lesson plans will be approved by the department chairperson and/or the curriculum assistant principal. All lesson plans will follow the district lesson plan template.
